products.name: Alvor Vase
products.description: A tall bottle-form vase wrapped in a pierced diamond lattice, tapering to a narrow neck. The open weave throws shadow across itself and lets light through the body. Available in two sizes. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Apex Vase
products.description: A teardrop silhouette with a crisply faceted diamond lower body that gives way to fine vertical fluting at the neck. The two textures meet mid-body in a single clean transition. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Briosi Planter
products.description: An open lattice planter built from interwoven vertical strands that form elongated leaf-shaped openings around the body. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Drift Lamp
products.description: A table lamp assembled from separate printed parts — an open lattice globe base beneath a finely ribbed drum shade. Sold as printed parts only, with no electrical components included; it takes an E14 lamp kit with plug and switch, supplied separately. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Evolve Planter
products.description: A rounded bowl planter cut with a diamond lattice, sized specifically for IKEA FEJKA artificial plants. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Evora Vase
products.description: A tall, slender urn form in matte charcoal, its profile interrupted by layered vertical fins that peel away from the body and catch the light. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Romeu Vase
products.description: A generous onion-form vase with deep vertical flutes radiating from a narrow neck across the widest part of the body. Substantial in the hand — the geometry uses a lot of material. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Sintra Vase
products.description: A clean bottle silhouette banded around its middle with an interlocking serpentine weave, left smooth above and below so the texture reads as a deliberate inset rather than an all-over pattern. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Tavira Planter
products.description: A spherical planter worked in a chevron relief, finished with a screw-in drip plate that lifts it clear of the surface. The plate prints separately, so a contrasting colour is easy. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Vanta Vase
products.description: A teardrop form wrapped in spiralling ribs that twist from base to neck, so the surface shifts as you move around it. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Wavy Planter
products.description: A rounded planter under soft wavy flutes, sitting in its own wrap-around drip tray. The tray prints separately for a two-tone pairing. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Wavy Vase
products.description: A rounded bulb of wavy diagonal ribs drawn up into a slim neck, seated in a matching wrap-around plate. Print the plate in a contrasting colour for a two-tone finish. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

products.name: Wisp Vase
products.description: Classic proportions dressed in fine vertical ribs that separate as they curve around the body, opening onto the interior and giving the surface real depth. 3D printed to order in your choice of colour. Designed by h3li0.

_pricing_workflow: Prices are PROVISIONAL until the item is printed. Real pricing comes from slicing for the K2 Plus and reading actual filament weight + machine time off the gcode. h3li0's 3MF files carry Bambu X1C profiles, so their estimates do not transfer. Fill print_time_min / filament_g / material_cost when printed, then set price_confirmed=true.
_publish_rule: Do not publish a product to the website until printed=true and price_confirmed=true. A listing implies you can ship it in the stated lead time.
